description: `aspire config set` for experimental polyglot AppHost languages (Java, Go, Python, Rust) now uses flat feature keys (e.g., `experimentalPolyglotJava`) instead of colon-separated names, which previously produced an invalid nested `features` object. Existing settings using the old `experimentalPolyglot:java`-style keys must be renamed to the new flat key names.
name: Fix experimental polyglot AppHost feature key names
